name: Buddhism
overview: Scripture reveals that eternal life and true hope are found only through Jesus Christ, who declares Himself as the sole way to the Father and the source of truth and life. The promise that all who have died will hear His voice and be raised underscores the certainty of resurrection and judgment. Furthermore, God's ultimate plan includes wiping away all sorrow and pain, bringing a new reality where death and suffering are no more, contrasting sharply with any other worldview that does not center on Christ's redemptive work.
